# Logical model reference

Conventions (standard columns, IDs, scope keys) are in [../02-logical-model.md](../02-logical-model.md). Every entity also has the standard columns for its scope, lifecycle and concurrency class.

## Execution platform (`execution`, schema `exec`)

Logical operations and attempts, idempotency keys, durable job queue, transactional outbox and consumer inbox, external-effect ledger.

<a id="entity-operation"></a>

One logical operation (AI action, agent run, automation run, sync, import, export, bulk edit, brand move, purge, webhook delivery). Carries the single logical outcome.
